examples: View radius is +1, plus +1 every 5 hero levels. Rough-terrain movement penalty modifier is -100%.

suggestions.regex: ^Army (?<stat>Luck|Morale) is \+(?<base>\d+)\. Friendly units have \+(?<bonus>\d+)% (?<bonus_type>critical chance|additional action chance), plus \+(?<step>\d+)% every (?<interval>\d+) hero levels\.$

Army Morale is +1. Friendly units have +2% additional action chance, plus +1% every 4 hero levels.

suggestions.regex: ^Hero spell damage is \+(?<hero_bonus>\d+)%, plus \+(?<hero_step>\d+)% every (?<hero_interval>\d+) hero levels\. Enemy hero spell damage is -(?<enemy_bonus>\d+)%, plus -(?<enemy_step>\d+)% every (?<enemy_interval>\d+) hero levels\.$
examples: Hero spell damage is +10%, plus +1% every 2 hero levels. Enemy hero spell damage is -10%, plus -1% every 2 hero levels.

suggestions.regex: ^Maximum Mana is \+(?<bonus>\d+)%, plus \+(?<step>\d+)% every (?<interval>\d+) hero levels\. Spell uses per round are \+(?<spell_uses>\d+)\.$

limitations: These suggestions were derived from the current live English Core.zip only, so any patch or overlay regeneration should revalidate the text families and counts.
The list intentionally favors high-reuse families in the requested files and does not exhaustively cover every singleton English string.
The live archive exposes hero specialization content through heroInfo.json rather than a separate heroesSpecialist.json file, so those rows are covered here by heroInfo patterns.
